definitions.explanation: A museum with hands-on exhibits about science and technology, often aimed at letting visitors learn through experiments and displays.

examples.japanese: {科学館|かがくかん}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: We went to the science museum.

examples.japanese: {科学館|かがくかん}でロボットの{展示|てんじ}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I saw a robot exhibit at the science museum.

examples.japanese: {科学館|かがくかん}では{実際|じっさい}に{触|さわ}って{学|まな}べる{展示|てんじ}が{人気|にんき}だ。
examples.english: At the science museum, exhibits you can actually touch and learn from are popular.

notes:
Formed from {科学|かがく} (science) + {館|かん} (hall, building). A facility, often public, with interactive exhibits on science and technology; the suffix {館|かん} appears in many building names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {科学館|かがくかん}を{訪|おとず}れる: visit a science museum
- {科学館|かがくかん}の{展示|てんじ}: a science museum exhibit
- プラネタリウムのある{科学館|かがくかん}: a science museum with a planetarium

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {博物館|はくぶつかん}: museum — broader, covering history and nature; a {科学館|かがくかん} focuses on science with hands-on displays
